feature_name: Vertex AI Search layout parser HTML content exclusion
summary: The layout parser now allows skipping specified HTML content during parsing using configurable exclusions such as tags, IDs, and CSS classes to reduce irrelevant boilerplate and improve indexed data quality.
extended_definition: The layout parser now allows skipping specified HTML content during parsing using configurable exclusions such as tags, IDs, and CSS classes to reduce irrelevant boilerplate and improve indexed data quality.

evidence_snippets: The Document AI Layout Parser transforms documents in various formats into structured representations, making content like paragraphs, tables, lists, and structural elements like headings, page headers, and footers accessible, and creating context-aware chunks that facilitate information retrieval in a range of generative AI and discovery apps.
